facts.text: W Las Vegas is on the Las Vegas Strip.
facts.excerpt: At the pulse of the Las Vegas Strip, W Las Vegas channels bold energy and a fresh perspective into the city of limitless possibilities.

facts.text: W Las Vegas is an all-suite hotel, with many suites offering views of the Las Vegas skyline.
facts.excerpt: Step into an all-suite destination where modern style meets effortless comfort, many offering sweeping views of the iconic Las Vegas skyline.

facts.text: The suites have a sleek, sophisticated design.
facts.excerpt: Spacious all-suite guestrooms with sleek, sophisticated design.

facts.text: Rooms offer views of the Las Vegas Strip and the desert landscape.
facts.excerpt: Stunning views of the Las Vegas Strip and desert landscape.

facts.text: BATHHOUSE Spa is a co-ed spa.
facts.excerpt: BATHHOUSE Spa is where relaxation meets community in a unique co-ed environment.

facts.text: BATHHOUSE Spa has plunge pools, steam rooms and saunas.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy our luxurious amenities, including therapeutic plunge pools, invigorating steam rooms, and calming saunas.

facts.text: Skyfall Rooftop Bar and Lounge offers a panoramic overlook of the city with artisan cocktails and shareable appetizers.
facts.excerpt: With the combination of flowing cocktails and glowing moonlight, the panoramic overlook of the city from Skyfall is surreal. Enjoy artisan cocktails and shareable appetizers

facts.text: Living Room is a social hub at the heart of the hotel serving signature cocktails.
facts.excerpt: At the heart of W Las Vegas, Living Room is a vibrant social hub where elevated design meets undeniable energy. Sip signature cocktails, settle in with friends

facts.text: 3940 Coffee and Tea serves quick bites and drinks.
facts.excerpt: Perfect for a quick bite or refreshing beverage.

facts.text: Guests must be 21 or older to check in.
facts.excerpt: Must be 21+ for check-in or to play.
No, room service is not offered at W Las Vegas.
Yes, pets are welcome at W Las Vegas.

facts.text: The hotel has electric vehicle charging stations.
facts.excerpt: Yes, W Las Vegas has electric vehicle charging stations (subject to availability).

facts.text: Staff speak English, Korean, Chinese and Spanish.
Both self parking and valet parking are available on site.
facts.excerpt: Self parking is available for $20.00 per day. Valet parking is available for $40.00 per day.
